messages: kevin (Design): quick check-in 10 need to pick a single required-field signal for Settings pages and decide validation behavior for the 3-step onboarding wizard. also quick copy for team delete. olga (PM): lay out 2 options + rec please. riley (DevEx): a11y note up front: SRs must reliably hear required state and when a validation summary appears. avoid color-only. sam (Eng): prefer low variance across the product; implementation complexity comes from focus management in wizards. kevin (Design): Option 1: asterisk on labels + small legend at top for long pages. Option 2: muted "Required" micro-label/pill next to label for denser pages. both include sr-only "required" and aria-required on inputs. kevin (Design): compact example: " required". legend used when many required fields would be repetitive. olga (PM): for the wizard, users miss inline errors when they're scrolled. recommend an error-summary at the top of each step with anchor links and keyboard focus jump. riley (DevEx): yes. summary must be aria-live polite when it appears and each anchor should focus the field and announce its label+error. also ensure inputs have aria-describedby pointing to error text. sam (Eng): implementation note: use data-error-id attributes and one handler to focus + scroll. debounce validation updates (300ms) to avoid frequent DOM churn. kevin (Design): delete-team copy options: "Delete team" vs "Permanently delete team" vs "Delete team and all data". i'm leaning explicit. olga (PM): explicit wins. recommend "Permanently delete team" + typed-confirm for org-level teams, modal + undo toast for lightweight deletes. riley (DevEx): typed-confirm accessibility checklist: clear label, instructions in aria-describedby, primary disabled until match (aria-disabled), mismatch announced with role=alert, focus trap. include keyboard walkthrough in QA. sam (Eng): backend supports 14-day soft-delete today; if we say "restore within 14 days" we must confirm with legal/product. client-side match check is cheap; avoid server calls on every keystroke. bot-a11y: reminder: run SR smoke tests after PR is open. kevin (Design): decision summary: use asterisk + sr-only for most Settings, micro-label/pill for narrow/dense layouts, inline errors for single-step screens, step-level error summary with anchors for wizards, and "Permanently delete team" modal with typed-confirm for org-level deletes + undo toast for light deletes. i'll update the spec and Figma and add acceptance criteria. olga (PM): i'll confirm recovery messaging with legal and flag threshold for typed-confirm. riley (DevEx): i'll add accessibility acceptance criteria to the ticket and a keyboard checklist. sam (Eng): i'll add debounce + focus-jump implementation notes to the PR. kevin (Design): thanks all :thumbsup: will post the updated spec in the handoff ticket."
